title: Beyond Binary Moderation: Identifying Fine-Grained Sexist and Misogynistic Behavior on GitHub with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of developing and evaluating a multi-class classifier using LLMs to detect sexist and misogynistic behavior in GitHub comments. While the topic concerns social harms, the study does not involve benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or the models' internal ethical/moral frameworks; rather, it evaluates their efficacy as content moderation tools based on behavioral definitions.
